owner_notes: The user's current production mode is GitHub-mounted owner authority plus GPT chat execution; Site/MCP deployment is optional/future and is not required for GITHUB_CHAT execution.

The Python state machine remains the higher-assurance executable reference and owner-native path; GITHUB_CHAT is a bounded CHAT_BRIDGED adapter, not a claim that Python owner-runtime execution occurred.

Repository wiring does not prove the current ChatGPT session can execute the adapter. GITHUB_CHAT is session-executable only when the model, GitHub write surface and deterministic github_chat_guard (plus exact-stage web/document capabilities) are actually available now.

CHAT_BRIDGED generation/review is legal only through the explicit GITHUB_CHAT adapter, guard-accepted state transitions and action-bound receipts; free-form publishable output from INTAKE is not a degraded mode.

GITHUB_CHAT may narrow assurance but may not narrow owner business semantics: TaskContract defaults, delivery channel and required outputs remain adapter-invariant unless the user's prompt contains auditable override evidence.

A GITHUB_CHAT review is CHAT_SELF_REVIEW and a chat execution receipt is SELF_ATTESTED_CHAT_EXECUTION_RECEIPT. Either may prove bounded action/route evidence but neither certifies Python semantic PASS, INDEPENDENT_EXECUTOR or provider-attested isolation.
The historical AuditProvenance label INDEPENDENT_EXECUTOR denotes only a separate stage-bound owner-runtime judge run. It must not be represented as provider-attested or ATTESTED_ISOLATED evidence.

Material feedback captured through GITHUB_CHAT must use the guard to persist owner-local evidence and an OPEN system-impact item together; it must not fabricate an owner-plugin methodology receipt when that runtime is unavailable.

Owner-generated methodology receipts remain UNVERIFIED_OWNER_RECEIPT and cannot self-certify Universal operational methodology conformance. Receipt 1.3 binds the owner record to an exact action, but Universal must still supply the independent action expectation and evidence/semantic verifiers.

The current general editorial quality corpus is NOT promotion-ready even for FINANCE_DEEP because only one complete held-out FINANCE_DEEP topic family exists. This execution-mode repair does not change that quality evidence ceiling and does not prove prose quality improved.
Verifier callback presence is not independent execution attestation. Any claim of independent semantic verification still requires an execution identity/trace outside the owner harness.
